changelog:
Initial release – integrates OpenAI Agents SDK with You.com MCP server:

- Provides guided workflow for selecting language (Python or TypeScript) and MCP server configuration (Hosted or Streamable HTTP).
- Includes installation steps and environment variable setup for You.com and OpenAI API keys.
- Offers code snippets and full ready-to-run templates for both Python and TypeScript.
- Supports integration into new or existing files with clear instructions.
- Licensed under MIT and compatible with Python 3.10+ or Node.js 18+ with TypeScript.
